title: Tool-call timeout / failure with retry
edgeCase: Edge Case 6 -- tool call failure mid-workflow (idempotency)
description: A LOW-tier action's external tool call fails on the first attempt (simulated timeout), then the workflow retries.
expectedBehavior: The system must verify current state before blindly retrying, and the underlying executor must never be invoked more than once for the same idempotency key -- no duplicate external action, even though the first attempt failed and a second attempt was made for the same triggering event.
